title: Hideaway Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Our 80 site campground includes: 25 electric/water/sewer sites, 11 electric/water sites, 36 unserviced sites, 7 camping cabins (including one Lighthouse Replica Cabin) and 2 Glam Tent. We provide a hiking trail 500 meters to the Aspy River, where you can swim, fish or kayak. If you launch your canoe or kayak at the end of the trail you will be able to paddle along the Aspy River, head to Middle Harbour or out to the Atlantic Ocean. When hiking back you can take the long trail (2.2 km) along the river or short trail (1km) through the woods back to the campground. All trails are clearly marked with distances for your convenience. The playground is centrally located for all children to enjoy,

services.name: On-Site RV Rental
services.desc: Our 80 site campground includes: 25 electric/water/sewer sites, 11 electric/water sites, 36 unserviced sites, 7 camping cabins (including one Lighthouse Replica Cabin) and 2 Glam Tent. 38′ trailer with 3 slide-outs, this luxurious unit offers all the comforts of home. Equipped with master bedroom with king size bed, leather living room furniture with double pull out couch. Satellite TV and electric fireplace in living room. Three piece bath all towels and linens provided. Kitchen with full size fridge, stove, kettle, microwave, toaster, coffee maker, all dishes, pots and cutlery. 2 night minimum stay. Sorry, no pets are allowed. No smoking permitted. 48 hour cancellation

services.name: Camping Cabins
services.desc: We have 7 camping cabins (including one Lighthouse Replica Cabin) based on an open room concept, 3 of the cabins will sleep 5 people comfortably. The other four will accommodate 2 people. Each are privately located throughout the campground. All cabins come with beds, a dining table and chairs, an outdoor fire pit

blurb: Located at the half way point on the magnificent Cabot Trail, Hideaway Campground and Oyster Market is on the boundary of the Cape Breton Highland National Park in the beautiful coastal community of South Harbour.
